subject: Re: Azure private offer - frontloaded credits & 2yr ramp scope
messages:
From: Sara Wong <sara.wong@novacorp.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Patel <michael.patel@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring Azure private offer: frontloaded credits & 2yr ramp

Hi Logan / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product overview yesterday. Procurement asked me to consolidate the ask so we can move to marketplace paperwork. A few items they need clarity on before they sign off: 

- We have a spike in usage for months 1-2 while we onboard and run a pilot. Would Redwood consider frontloading credits (marketplace credit redemption) against an annual prepay so we don’t breach internal cost thresholds in month 1?
- We’re envisioning a 2-year prepay: Year 1 heavier (60% of total) to cover early ramp, Year 2 catches up (40%). Is Redwood comfortable with a phasing like that and what discount would you offer on a 2yr committed prepay versus 1yr?
- If unused credits remain at year end, can they roll forward into year 2 under the private offer or do we need a new commitment?
- Any marketplace constraints (Azure private offers) we should be aware of for frontloaded credit mechanics or refunds/cancellations?

Procurement attached our forecast and a preliminary SOW for context. We’re aiming to close paperwork by end of October. Can you confirm a timeline for pricing & legal review?

Appreciate it — Sarah

Attachments: Novacorp_Spend_Forecast.xlsx (xlsx), SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Wong <sara.wong@novacorp.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring Azure private offer: frontloaded credits & 2yr ramp

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick answers and a proposed structure below.

1) Frontloaded credits: Yes — we can structure a frontloaded credit that redeems as Azure marketplace credits applied at invoice-time. Typically we model this as a portion of the Year 1 prepay (we suggest 25–35% of Year 1) available to cover pilot/onboarding spend. That credit is consumed first against monthly usage.

2) Two-year phasing & discount: For a 2yr prepay where customer prepays both years up front, we can offer an additional term discount. If Novacorp prepays both years up front we can offer a blended discount in the range of ~18–22% off list, subject to final commit size and telemetry. If you prefer an 60/40 cashflow (prepay Year1 heavier), we can model either:
  - Option A: Prepay both years up front — full term discount (higher).
  - Option B: Year1 prepay now (larger % frontloaded), Year2 invoice at 12-month mark with PI true-up — lesser term discount but more flexibility.

3) Roll-forward of unused credits: Azure private offers do allow credit redemption rules to be specified, but roll-forward is a policy we have to set in the offer terms. Our recommendation (to avoid audit complexity) is to allow credits to roll into Year 2 only if both years are prepaid under the same private offer; otherwise unused Year 1 credits expire on the anniversary.

4) Marketplace constraints & cancellation: Azure requires private offers to specify refund/cancel mechanics — marketplace-hosted credit grants are irreversible in most cases. If you need refundability, we can add a limited retention carve-out (e.g., refundable up to X% within 30 days) but that typically reduces the available term discount.

Proposed starter structure (for modeling):
  - Deal term: 24 months
  - Total prepay: $1,200,000 list (example)
  - Year1 cash allocation: $720,000 (60%) with 30% of Year1 provided as frontloaded marketplace credits (applied month 1–3)
  - Year2 cash allocation: $480,000 (40%), prepaid at contract signature or at 12-month invoice depending on option
  - Blended term discount: 18% with option to expand to 20% if both years prepaid up front
  - Minimum annual commitment: 12 months

I’ve attached a short PDF with the pricing scenarios so you can run numbers with procurement. If this looks directionally right, we’ll:
  - Lock in the frontload % and refundability with Legal
  - Draft the Azure private offer language (credits redemption and roll-forward rules)
  - Post the private offer in your Azure tenant for signature (DocuSign link will be provided)

Timeline: We can produce a draft private offer and price memo within 2 business days; legal review typically adds 3–5 business days depending on redlines.

Will loop Marcus into the thread for finance review.

- Logan

Attachment: redwood_azure_po_pricing.pdf (pdf)

Logan — this is very helpful, thanks. A couple of follow-ups from procurement: 

- Please confirm whether the frontloaded credits are issued as Azure Marketplace credit line items (so they appear on the Azure invoice) OR as account-level Redwood credits applied off-invoice. Procurement prefers Marketplace line-item credits for forecasting.
- If we accept Option B (prepay Year1 now, Year2 at 12 months), will the Year1 frontload still be protected (i.e., not reclaimed) if we miss a Year2 prepay?
- Can you send the HubSpot deal link and a DocuSign preview so our legal can review expected flow?

We’re targeting signature by 10/29 assuming pricing and terms align.

Thanks — Sarah

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Azure private offer - frontloaded credits & 2yr ramp (internal recs)

Kim / Marcus — forwarding Novacorp thread with procurement asks. My recommended approach to close this by 10/29: 

On the credit mechanics: offer marketplace line-item credits (preferred by Novacorp) equal to 30% of Year1 prepaid and state in the private offer that credits roll into Year2 only if Year2 is prepaid under the same PO. If Year2 is not prepaid by the anniversary, unused Year1 credits expire. That protects our revenue recognition while giving procurement the visibility they want.

On commercials: propose blended 18% term discount for a 24-month commitment with the following optional sweeteners:
  - 20% if customer prepays both years up front (cash locked)
  - 2-months of free support onboarding (technical credits) applied in months 1–3

Risks/questions: Azure private offers may require the credits to be non-refundable — legal will need to craft language around cancellation and audit. Marcus — can finance confirm if we can accept a rollback clause where refunds reduce Tier discount pro rata? Also confirm ARR reporting impact if Year2 not prepaid.

If we agree, I’ll:
  - Lock pricing memo & send DocuSign preview to Sarah
  - Ask Legal to template the private offer credit language (no roll-forward unless both years prepaid)
  - Post hubspot note and move to Firm Proposal stage (deal id NOV-2319-AZ)

Thoughts?

- Logan
